title: Lidar-detected pyramid in the Amazon

tellings.quote: um they have identified what their certain is an enormous pyramid wow in the middle of the Amazon rainforest

plain: Archaeologists are said to have found what they are certain is "an enormous pyramid" deep in the Colombian Amazon rainforest, using lidar, a laser scan from the air that can map the ground beneath thick forest. The writer Graham Hancock, who argues that a lost ancient civilisation existed, told Michels this in 2022 and credits it to an archaeologist at the University of Exeter whom he does not name. If true, it would mean large-scale building existed where the rainforest was long thought to have held none.
